[in LXX: Jdg.5:17 (חוֹף), Sir.24:14 * ;]
the sea-shore, beach (cf. Field, Notes, 146; DCG, i, 175 f.; MM, VGT, see word): Mat.13:2,48 Jhn.21:4, Act.21:5 27:39,40.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.
But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.
When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city.…
